name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent in shadow mode on the newest open PR first. It catches routing errors before they reach users, reducing bad PRs by up to 30% based on past runs. The trade-off is delayed feedback for the PR author—shadow mode doesn’t block merges, so fixes come after the fact. This is the fastest way to validate routing accuracy without disrupting workflows.

name: Gauge
text: Shadow mode on open PRs risks slowing reviews by adding noise to every conversation—authors waste time addressing false positives instead of shipping. Better: run PR-Agent in shadow mode on merged PRs first, then expand to open PRs only if error rates justify the cost. Settle it by measuring review time and error rate before/after for one sprint.
